description: viber hooks. The SessionStart hook shows the user the loaded plugin version, with a schema note when .claude/viber.yml is at another schema than the setup template, and injects hooks/content/manifest.md verbatim into the main session's context (source == "resume" excluded, since the prior injection reloads with the transcript). The PreToolUse hook on ExitPlanMode (plan-gate.sh) guards a plan the planner skill built: armed only when the records after the last ExitPlanMode that was not refused hold a Skill call of planner or a call of its plan.sh, and disarmed by a Skill call that was not refused or a typed command of simple-plan after the last of those, it refuses the exit unless a plan.sh land call wrote the plan, viber:plan-reviewer was dispatched after the last such landing, the last such dispatch returned VERDICT: PASS and the plan file was not edited since; every refusal names the next step. Any other plan passes untouched, a pass takes no permission decision, and the gate fails open: unreadable input or no node lets the call through.
